commands.command:
set -eu
root=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos
repo="$root/photomap/work"
printf 'MAC_REPO_ROOT_EXISTS=%s\n' "$(test -d "$root" && echo yes || echo no)"
printf 'PHOTOMAP_PARENT_EXISTS=%s\n' "$(test -d "$root/photomap" && echo yes || echo no)"
printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORK_EXISTS=%s\n' "$(test -d "$repo" && echo yes || echo no)"
if test -d "$repo"; then
  printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORK_GIT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || echo no)"
  printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORK_TOP=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo unavailable)"
  printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORK_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unavailable)"
  printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORK_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unavailable)"
  printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORK_ORIGIN=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || echo unavailable)"
  printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORK_DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain=v1 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
  printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORKTREES_BEGIN\n'
  git -C "$repo" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null || true
  printf 'PHOTOMAP_WORKTREES_END\n'
fi
printf 'REPO_FOLDER_MATCHES_BEGIN\n'
if test -d "$root"; then find "$root" -maxdepth 3 -type d -iname '*photo*' -print; fi
printf 'REPO_FOLDER_MATCHES_END\n'
echo PHOTOMAP_MAC_LOCAL_REPO_LOCATION_COMPLETE
